one_line: Minimalist monochrome event page with a bold organic logo and clear typographic hierarchy
typography: Custom organic sans-serif logo (fluid, hand-drawn feel) > clean sans-serif event name > bold sans-serif date/location > smaller sans-serif service list (hierarchy via size/weight)
layout_grid: Left-aligned logo (occupying ~1/3 width), right-aligned date/location (1/3 width), middle-right service list (1/3 width), bottom-right CTA button—grid-aligned with generous white space for balance
color_shape_legibility: High-contrast black-on-white for maximum readability; organic logo shape adds visual personality without cluttering, using negative space to keep focus on key text
deck_transferable: Using a bold, custom organic logo as the slide's primary visual focal point
Aligning key text elements (event name, date, location) to a left-right grid for balanced composition
Employing a high-contrast monochrome palette (black on white) to ensure clarity in static slides
Placing a call-to-action button in a fixed bottom-right position for clear next steps
Leveraging ample white space to avoid visual overload and guide attention
web_only_skip: 3D depth or motion graphics (static deck format)
